_meta.hit_rate: share of 2024-2026 releases reaching the success proxy per research corpus 29 (estimates)

coop_3d.label: 3D co-op ('friendslop')
coop_3d.evidence: R.E.P.O. ~18M, Peak ~16M, Schedule I ~8M (estimated); eight new indies passed 100k CCU in 2025
coop_3d.notes: proximity voice + emergent comedy + streamable moments; stylized not photoreal; EA-friendly

survival_craft.label: survival-craft / sim / management
survival_craft.evidence: 20.8% hit rate per release - the best measured

horror.label: horror (small 3D teams)
horror.evidence: #3 genre by release count; best count-volume for small 3D teams

f2p_live_service.label: new F2P live-service
f2p_live_service.evidence: graveyard: Concord dead in 2 weeks; XDefiant/MultiVersus/Dauntless shut; Sony cancelled 8 of 12

extraction_shooter.label: extraction shooter
extraction_shooter.evidence: ARC Raiders 16.3M by Q2 2026 - winners exist but head-to-head with them

opportunity_map.what: 3D co-op $8-25, physics/proximity-voice emergent comedy, streamable moments, stylized, EA-friendly

opportunity_map.avoid: platformers (0.18%), pure puzzle (0.34%), new F2P live-service, fighting the 60% back-catalog gravity well

opportunity_map.strategy: premium co-op with light post-launch (Helldivers 2 / ARC Raiders model) over F2P; EA launch IS the launch; >=7-10k wishlists before Next Fest

price_resistance.note: $80 tier met resistance (Xbox reversed); sub-$30 PC +40% since 2022; small-team sweet spot $10-25

ai_disclosure.note: ~20% of 2025 Steam releases disclosed gen-AI; Valve disclosure required since Jan 2024; sentiment 85% negative (QF) but only ~25% say it reduces purchases (Circana) - backlash concentrates on visible sloppy assets and voice replication
